name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r3
slot_change_request: quant_NW_xp_ctl: master ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl -> ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r3 (two 6-bit strap pins rl_cfg/wc_cfg on W, tied by the soft parent to RLI = RL+4+2*XR / WCI = WC+2+XR); outline 86.4 -> 108 um square (NPMAX 48 command pipeline) -> H-D4G-GEN2.

job.purpose: Strap-latency QUANT transport controller for the d4g split r2: one closed tile for any die relay count. Bench = the exact split r2 lockstep against the monolith at XR 0 (RLI 11/WCI 6) and XR 12 (RLI 35/WCI 18).

benches.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R2_mutant2
benches.why: 12 relay stages present, straps priced for 11: the controller rr_v check / write timing is one edge off

structural_change: ctl r3: ctl_r2 (cmd pin registers + reset relay, native PASS) with the read round trip / write commit as registered STRAPS instead of parameters (strap-selected taps on the command and commit pipelines, NPMAX 48 / WCMAX 32, out-of-range strap = sticky fault). Closed once for every die relay count XR and VM latency RL (7, or 9 with share2); the v1/r2 views are closed only at RL9/WC5, which the split r2 (LG r2 +2/dir, XR relays) never uses.

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin already (ctl_r3 captures every cmd_* and strap bit at its pin, rr_v/vo/qfault/decode_fault enter flops, every output is a register, rst_n drives only the 3-flop relay): ctl_r2 with the same boundary is native PASS (launch 181.2, capture 138.1, 0 comb). Extra tool pin registers would add edges the split r2 lockstep does not price.
